candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to acc.balance with a constant value so Put always sets balance to msg.value ignoring previous balance.
Change unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the user-provided unlock time.
Change the balance increment by subtracting msg.value instead of adding it.
Delete the require overflow check statement, allowing overflow to corrupt balance.
Replace 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am)' with 'acc.balance = acc.balance' so the balance is not reduced on collect.
Replace the condition 'acc.balance>=MinSum && acc.balance>=_am && block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' with 'true' so Collect always proceeds regardless of balance or unlock time.
Delete the entire if-guard condition so Collect always executes the withdrawal logic.
Replace the ETH transfer call 'msg.sender.call{value: _am}("")' with a zero-value call 'msg.sender.call{value: 0}("")' so the user receives no ETH on collect.
Replace 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am)' with 'acc.balance = (acc.balance + _am)' so the balance increases instead of decreasing.
Delete the balance decrement statement so the user's recorded balance is never reduced on collect.
